result_text:
The warehouse stock list no longer shows products with quantity 0. I ran the full test suite with `mvn -q -o test` and it passed. I didn't add a test for the zero-quantity case.

The change is one line, in `listStockByWarehouse` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStorePart02.java`. It adds `AND s.quantity > 0` to the query, the same filter the other stock overviews use.

Asking for the quantity of a single product in a warehouse still answers 0 for nuts, because that lookup is a separate query that I left alone.
